name: Bridge
summary: Decouples an abstraction from its implementation so that the two can vary independently.

reference.author: Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson, John Vlissides

roles.name: Abstraction
roles.summary: Defines the abstraction's interface and holds a reference to an implementor.

roles.name: RefinedAbstraction
roles.summary: Extends the interface defined by the abstraction, without touching the implementation side.

roles.name: Implementor
roles.summary: Declares the primitive operations the abstraction is built upon.

roles.name: ConcreteImplementor
roles.summary: Provides one concrete implementation of the primitive operations.
